detail.longDescription: Searched a PDF for a word you can clearly see on the page, and got nothing? The page is probably a picture of text, usually because it was scanned or photographed. There's no text behind the image, so search, copy and screen readers all come up empty. Quick test: press and hold a word. If it won't select, the file needs text recognition (OCR) before search will work. # PDF # Accessibility # Productivity
